## 2026-07-09 - IDTS-71 AI security and prompt-misuse review

| Classification | Symptom / work | Root cause | Fix status | Verification / next action |

| Security hardening | Started `IDTS-71` on `feature/idts-71-ai-security-review-donhv` to verify AI prompt data leakage, provider-output misuse, safe rendering, and no unauthorized workflow mutation. | The AI features from IDTS-64 to IDTS-70 are suggestion-only, but the final security pass needed a focused negative/security harness before final QA acceptance. | In progress. Added `scripts/qa/test-idts71-ai-security-review.js` for local programmatic checks and `scripts/qa/test-idts71-render-ai-smoke.js` for shared-QA Render smoke with private env variables. | Local focused verification passed `npm run qa:idts71:programmatic` with `31 PASS / 0 FAIL`. Continue AI regression, CAP compile, secret scan, lint, and PR creation. |
| Product security defect | Classification suggestions could previously trim provider `reason` text but did not treat an unsafe provider payload as a full unsafe-output condition. | `srv/ai/classification-suggestion.js` validated catalog values, but provider-output safety handling was weaker than `bug-summary.js` and `assignment-explanation.js`. | Fixed by marking unsafe provider payload as `AI_OUTPUT_UNSAFE`, ignoring provider values/reasons, and returning safe fallback/review copy. | Covered by `qa:idts71:programmatic`: unsafe classification provider output no longer leaks SQL/token/provider diagnostics and does not mutate `Bugs`. |
| Environment/private-config blocker | Render AI smoke initially failed because the local smoke env did not match the actual Render QA seed identities/password hashes. | The script env only controls which credentials are tried; it does not reset password hashes in Render PostgreSQL. The Render DB also still used `.example.local` seed emails. | Resolved for IDTS-71 smoke by adding the current DonHV IP to the Render PostgreSQL allow list, resetting the four seed QA password hashes to the shared test password through Render `psql`, and running the smoke with the actual seed email. | `npm run qa:idts71:render-smoke` passed on shared QA with `25 PASS / 0 FAIL`. Evidence is saved at `docs/pm/evidence/idts-71-ai-security-review/render-ai-smoke.json`; no token/password/DB URL is included. |
| Test-harness issue | First authenticated Render smoke run reached the AI checks but failed on a BugService read query because CAP rejected `+` in the encoded `$filter`. | `URLSearchParams(...).toString()` encoded spaces as `+`; the CAP OData parser expected `%20` for this query shape. | Fixed in `scripts/qa/test-idts71-render-ai-smoke.js` by adding `toODataQuery()` to replace `+` with `%20` for OData query strings. Also removed bearer-token value from evidence details. | Rerun passed `25 PASS / 0 FAIL`; focused evidence scan passed with no secret patterns. |
| Existing dependency finding | `npm ci --include=dev` reported existing npm vulnerabilities. | Existing project dependency state; remediation is already tracked separately by `IDTS-46`, not by this security review task. | Left unchanged. | Do not run broad `npm audit fix` in IDTS-71. |
| Tooling limitation | CAP MCP search returned only AuthService actions and did not surface the AI actions that are present in `srv/service.cds`. | MCP model context appears incomplete for this branch/session. | Used local source inspection and `cds compile` as authoritative verification instead. | Report this limitation in final handoff. |
| Tooling issue | Focused `npx eslint ...` failed before linting files because npx resolved ESLint 10 and no `eslint.config.*` exists in this repo. | The repo currently does not expose a root flat ESLint config or npm lint script for this focused command shape. | Not fixed in IDTS-71 because migrating ESLint config is outside the AI security review scope. | Used `node --check`, focused QA scripts, secret scan, AI DevKit lint, and `git diff --check` as the accepted verification set for this task. |

Vietnamese addendum for IDTS-55:

- **Phân loại**: Lỗi test-harness.
- **Triệu chứng**: `npm run qa:comments-attachments:http` fail `401 Unauthorized` ở bước `Delete previous draft if it exists`.
- **Nguyên nhân**: Script HTTP QA đã hỗ trợ Bearer token qua `IDTS_QA_BEARER_TOKEN`, nhưng lần chạy đầu chưa set biến này nên script fallback sang Basic Auth cũ. Basic Auth không còn hợp lệ sau khi dự án chuyển sang custom CAP auth.
- **Trạng thái**: Không phải product defect. Cần chạy lại cùng script với Bearer token mới lấy từ AuthService local.
- **Verification kỳ vọng**: HTTP script pass khi `IDTS_QA_BEARER_TOKEN` được set.
- **Ghi chú thêm**: Browser smoke lần đầu timeout khi chờ text `BUG-0001` visible vì Fiori có hidden title span trùng text. Đây là lỗi locator của test-harness, không phải product defect. Smoke sẽ được chỉnh để chờ control tương tác thật trong custom section, ví dụ ô nhập comment, rồi chạy lại toàn bộ comment/reload/upload/download/delete.
- **Ghi chú thêm**: Coverage command đầu tiên báo thiếu mirror dưới `docs/knowledge/bug-management-ui/...` vì command tự strip mất prefix `app/`. Convention đúng của repo là `docs/knowledge/app/bug-management-ui/...`. Đây là lỗi tooling command, không phải thiếu tài liệu.

| Classification | Symptom / work | Root cause | Fix status | Verification / next action |

## 2026-07-03 - UI/UX user-facing copy gate

| Process hardening | DonHV requested a strict rule so UI/UX work cannot repeat the IDTS-52 mistake of showing internal/dev-facing copy on user-visible screens. | The previous login redesign allowed QA/developer explanation text to reach the product UI because AGENTS.md did not yet have a merge-blocking user-facing copy gate. | Added a dedicated `User-Facing UI/UX Copy Gate` section to `AGENTS.md`, including forbidden copy examples, allowed user-focused wording, required PR evidence, and escalation for repeated violations. | Run focused `rg` checks, `git diff --check`, AI DevKit lint, then open PR into `dev`. |

| Temp ID | Area | Bug / Symptom | Current status | Root cause or note | Suggested SAP490 target |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TMP-BUG-01 | Backend / Attachments | Attachment upload created metadata but `content` stayed null after draft activation; download/content endpoint then returned empty or invalid result | Fixed | Custom child-media flow did not materialize `PUT .../content` body into `req.data.content` | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |
| TMP-BUG-02 | Fiori / Value Help | Assignee value help showed UUID-style fields and selection could end with `Not Found` / technical values instead of business names | Fixed | Value help and display text were bound to technical IDs / incomplete text handling | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |
| TMP-BUG-03 | UI / Object Page | Status was editable manually on Bug Detail although workflow should be action-driven and role-controlled | Fixed | UI field metadata was not fully locked to read-only | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |
| TMP-BUG-04 | Backend / Authorization | Role-based header actions disappeared unexpectedly for valid users or showed wrong behavior after login | Fixed | Mixed causes: stale server, omitted FE fields, case-sensitive user mapping, capability enrichment gaps | Test And Fix Bug, Technical Specification |
| TMP-BUG-05 | UI / Child Tables | Comments, History, Notifications remained editable in bug Edit mode when they should be read-only | Fixed | Missing create/delete hidden restrictions and incomplete field locking | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |
| TMP-BUG-06 | Backend / Draft | Draft edit could fail with unique constraint conflict around history ownership | Fixed | `Bugs.historyLogs` ownership conflicted with grouped `HistoryEvents.logs` during draft handling | Test And Fix Bug, Technical Specification |
| TMP-BUG-07 | UI / Attachments | Attachments section was hidden or locked out in some UI states even when backend path existed | Fixed | Annotation/facet visibility and stream-table configuration were incomplete during intermediate iterations | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |
| TMP-BUG-08 | UI / Readability | Comments/History tables displayed UUIDs instead of human-readable user names | Fixed | Missing flattened display fields / `Common.Text` usage for FE display | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |
| TMP-BUG-09 | UI / History UX | History showed too many low-level rows like `nextProcessorRole`, `nextProcessorUser`, raw status deltas, making the audit table noisy | Partially improved; follow-up review may still be needed | Required grouped `HistoryEvents` read model instead of only raw `HistoryLogs` | Functional Specification, possibly Technical Specification |
| TMP-BUG-10 | UI / Create Flow | Create Bug page did not expose attachment evidence even though attachments are valid at bug-report creation time | Fixed | Attachment facet had been intentionally hidden for brand-new draft create mode; Option A reopened it | Functional Specification, demo script update after fix |
| TMP-BUG-11 | Data / UX | Create page allows selecting invalid Application Component and Defect Category combinations that later fail on save | Fixed | `ValidDefectCategories` + `Common.ValueListParameterIn` now filter defect-category rows by selected component. Browser rerun confirmed `IDTS Fiori UI` only exposes `SAP Fiori UI5`, while `IDTS Bug Report` exposes only its valid categories. | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification, seed-data review |
| TMP-BUG-12 | UI / Attachment Refresh | Attachment uploaded during create draft disappears on the active Object Page right after save | Fixed | Fresh browser rerun on `localhost:4012` confirmed the uploaded file row remains visible immediately after create on the active Object Page. | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification, Technical Specification |
| TMP-BUG-13 | UI / Action Refresh | Object Page action buttons remain stale after lifecycle actions even when backend state changed | Fixed | Bound-action side effects now refresh capability/action state correctly. Browser rerun showed tester/developer/PM action sets changing to the right state during the happy flow. | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification |

| TMP-BUG-15 | UI / Assignment Workflow Consistency | Editing the `Assignee` field directly on Object Page previously bypassed assignment side effects, so the bug could stay `Pending Assignment` and create no assignment history/notification | Fixed | Root cause was duplicate assignment paths and missing update/draft-save side effects: the action dialog and editable field competed, `prepareBugWrite()` only derived `Assigned` on create, and draft activation did not record generic assignment changes. Current fix removes the UI action buttons, keeps backend action compatibility, uses the filtered `Assignee` field as the single UI path, derives status on assignee update, recalculates `nextProcessor`, and writes history/notification on draft save. | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification, Technical Specification |
| TMP-BUG-16 | UI / Edit Mode Governance | Generic Object Page edit mode still exposes workflow-sensitive fields such as `rejectionReason`, `plannedCompletionDate`, `dueDate`, and `estimatedEffortHours`, although the current MVP flow expects rejection to go through dedicated actions and planning is not part of the current happy-flow edit path | Code-side fixed, UI retest pending | `RejectedFollowUp` and `Planning` facets were previously only hidden for brand-new create draft, not for existing-bug edit mode; the underlying fields had no read-only or hide rule that matched the current business flow. Current fix makes the fields read-only, restricts `Rejected Follow-up` to rejected bugs, and hides `Planning` from the MVP Object Page. | Test And Fix Bug, Functional Specification, Technical Specification |
| TMP-BUG-17 | Data / Audit Integrity | A bug-edit governance gap allowed the local `Users.displayName` master data for `NhanT` to drift to `NhanTTestUserTesting User`, which then retroactively changed actor/reporter/comment names across old bug reports | Fixed for the current local/demo path | Root cause was a combination of writable user-facing bug fields/navigation-path display bindings and an unguarded service projection for master data. The local `db.sqlite` row was restored to `NhanT`, bug read-model display fields were flattened on `BugService.Bugs`, and `BugService` now rejects `CREATE/UPDATE/PATCH/DELETE` on `Users`, `DeveloperProfiles`, code lists, and system-managed audit/notification entities. | TMP-BUG-18 | Backend / CAP Draft Projection | Fiori preview List Report crashed on startup with SQLite error `no such column: $d.nextProcessorRoleName` after introducing flattened display fields on draft-enabled `BugService.Bugs` | Fixed | Root cause was two-layered: 1. inline projection expressions on a draft-enabled service entity caused CAP SQLite draft runtime to look for a non-physical draft-table column; 2. after converting them to `virtual` fields, the `after READ` enrichment still depended on `hasOwnProperty`, so CAP rows that omitted the virtual properties never received the display values. The final fix uses `virtual` service fields plus unconditional `after READ` enrichment. | Test And Fix Bug, Technical Specification |

The fix added `resubmitToDeveloper(note)` with required update summary, grouped history, follow-up comment, notification, and `nextProcessor` reset to the assigned Developer; `Rejected` was also tightened so it no longer routes back through `Need More Information` in MVP. | Functional Specification, UX backlog, Technical Specification |

### Additional tooling note

English: `gh pr diff 35 --check` failed because GitHub CLI does not support a `--check` option for `pr diff`. PR metadata was still read successfully and reported `MERGEABLE`. This was corrected by relying on the already-passed local `git diff --check` and using supported `gh pr diff` options only; no product source was affected.

| Dependency/configuration warning | Fresh merged-dev startup reports `cds.requires.<srv>.outbox` is deprecated and recommends `cds.requires.<srv>.outboxed`. | A dependency or current effective CAP configuration still uses the legacy outbox property name; exact owner is not yet isolated. | Open, non-blocking for PR #30 and the SQLite/login fix. | Locate the effective config source and handle as a focused CAP compatibility change with email/outbox regression tests; do not mix it into the login merge. |
| Test-harness issue | The first merged-dev browser smoke completed redirect, invalid login, valid login, metadata 200, Fiori render and logout, but exited 1 because it treated all UI5 console `error` messages as blocking; the first classifier rerun then retained the intentional invalid-login 401 as a later blocking error. | The smoke did not separate expected negative-test output from the valid-login/render phase and initially did not account for local-development misses such as `Component-preload.js` 404 or unavailable LREP flex endpoints; no page exception occurred. | Fixed in the one-off smoke classifier by clearing captured console errors after the intentional invalid-login assertion, then allowlisting only known non-blocking local-preview messages. | Rerun strict validation for valid login, metadata 200, app render and logout with zero unclassified errors. |

Chưa sửa code hoặc DB; cần backup DB trước nếu rebuild và cần duyệt/merge PR #30 để hoàn tất auth flow.

Final resolution: PR #30 was updated with current `dev`, verified, pushed, and merged as `207c773`. The local SQLite database was backed up, evolved with `schema_evolution=auto`, and verified to contain `idts_cap_NotificationDeliveries` while retaining 4 Bugs and 4 Users. One password hash overwritten by seed deployment was restored from backup without exposing its value. Fresh merged-dev browser smoke passed unauthenticated redirect, safe invalid login, valid login, OData metadata 200, Fiori render, and logout; server logs contained zero missing-table/outbox-worker failures.

Vietnamese: Kết quả cuối: PR #30 đã được cập nhật theo `dev`, verify, push và merge tại commit `207c773`. SQLite local đã được backup, evolve schema bằng `schema_evolution=auto`, có bảng `idts_cap_NotificationDeliveries` và vẫn giữ 4 Bugs/4 Users. Password hash bị seed ghi đè đã được phục hồi từ backup mà không lộ giá trị. Browser smoke trên merged `dev` pass redirect khi chưa login, login sai an toàn, login đúng, metadata OData 200, Fiori render và logout; log server không còn lỗi thiếu bảng/email worker.

## 2026-07-01 - IDTS-42 QA Depth Gate implementation

English:

| Classification | Symptom | Root cause | Fix status | Verification / next action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Test-harness issue | First `npm run qa:depth:self-test` run failed in the bare `N/A` case even though valid body and missing-section checks passed. | The newly added self-test expected a specific error message, but the validator classified bare `N/A` as too-thin content before reaching the explicit `N/A must include a reason` branch. | Fixed by checking bare `N/A` before minimum content length. | Fresh rerun: `QA Depth Gate self-test: 5 PASS / 0 FAIL`. |
| Environment/dependency issue | First CAP compile/auth/IDTS-41 verification in the new IDTS-42 worktree failed with missing `@sap/cds` / `@cap-js/attachments`. | The isolated worktree was created from Git only and did not have `node_modules`; this is workspace dependency setup, not a product code failure. | Fixed for local verification by using the existing root workspace dependency install through a local `node_modules` junction in the worktree. | Rerun CAP compile and programmatic QA after dependency link is available. |
| Test-harness/tooling issue | First PR-body stdin verification used `npm run qa:depth:pr-body -- --stdin` in a PowerShell pipeline and the validator reported every required section missing. | `npm` did not pass the `--stdin` argument to the script in this invocation shape and consumed the piped input before `check-pr-depth.js` read it. | Fixed for verification by invoking `node scripts/qa/check-pr-depth.js --stdin` directly; the workflow uses `--event`, so it is not affected. | Fresh direct rerun: `QA Depth Gate PR body check: PASS (9 required sections)`. Keep npm script for normal no-argument/event usage. |
| Process/test-harness issue | PR template said `Known Gaps` may be `None`, but the validator treated short content as too thin. | The gate was stricter than its own template for this one section. | Fixed by allowing exactly `None` only in `Known Gaps`; all other required sections still need evidence text or explained `N/A`. | Covered by self-test where `Known Gaps` is `None` and the valid PR body still passes. |
| Test-harness issue | Direct PR-body verification failed when an evidence sentence mentioned “Known Gaps value None” inside `Edge/Boundary Evidence`. | The untested-claim detector used a broad `none` substring match and treated explanatory text as if the whole section claimed no testing. | Fixed by detecting `None`, `not tested`, or `no tests` only when they appear as explicit untested claims. | Self-test now includes the phrase “Known Gaps value None” in edge evidence and still passes. |
| Tooling issue | `gh pr merge 38 --merge --delete-branch` failed locally with `fatal: 'dev' is already used by worktree at 'E:/IDTS-SAP01'`. | GitHub CLI attempted a local Git checkout/update that conflicts with the root repository worktree already using branch `dev`. | Fixed by merging PR #38 through the GitHub API, which does not require local checkout. | API merge returned merge commit `1181289d5a9753b7ef857912437f1f4d1192e1ad`; remote feature branch was deleted through GitHub API. |
| Process/tooling issue | After enabling branch protection, `qa-depth-gate` was required but the workflow still had a path filter. Docs-only PRs could become blocked because the required check might not run. | The original workflow was designed to gate only runtime/QA-path changes; once the check became required at branch level, it must appear on every PR to `dev`. | Fixed by removing the workflow path filter so `qa-depth-gate` runs on all PRs into `dev`. | Verify with PR for this fix: required check must appear and pass before merge. |

- Verification/owner: coordinator; final native export must report schema PASS and 0 issues.

- Classification: tooling issue.

- Affected tool/artifact: diagnostic console output only; the exported Google Sheets workbooks were opened successfully and no local or Drive artifact was modified.
- Root cause: the ad-hoc Python process inherited a non-UTF-8 console encoding.
- Status/fix: resolved by rerunning the inspection with `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` and limiting output to structural/content counts.
- Verification/owner: coordinator; confirm every sheet has the expected populated rows before final evidence is issued.

- Classification: tooling issue.
- Symptom: final `git diff --check` emitted working-copy warnings that Git may convert LF to CRLF for several edited Markdown, diagram-source, PM, and generator files.
- Affected tool/artifact: Git line-ending diagnostics only; the command still exited 0 and reported no whitespace error.
- Root cause: Windows working-tree line-ending policy differs from the LF content currently present in those files.
- Status/fix: accepted as a non-blocking tooling warning; no bulk normalization was performed because it would create unrelated churn and could disturb normalized-LF diagram evidence.
- Verification/owner: coordinator; `git diff --check` exit 0, and the diagram manifest's normalized-LF verification remains 21/21 PASS.

- Classification: tooling issue.
- Symptom: a read-only `rg --files` pipeline returned exit 1 while filtering generated Office artifacts with an overly narrow filename regex.
- Affected tool/artifact: diagnostic file discovery only; no file was modified or missing based on this command.
- Root cause: current generated naming/path conventions did not match the ad-hoc case-sensitive filter.
- Status/fix: resolved by enumerating the generated directory directly and selecting exact paths from the established artifact inventory.
- Verification/owner: coordinator; retain the already completed 31-artifact OfficeCLI gate as the authoritative inventory result.

## 2026-07-30 — IDTS-115 AI create-draft guard verification setup

- Classification: tooling issue.
- Symptom: the first regression/build batch in the fresh IDTS-115 worktree could not load `@sap/cds`, could not find the `ui5` executable, and the UI workspace has no `lint` npm script.
- Cause: the isolated worktree had not run `npm ci`; the attempted workspace lint alias does not exist in `app/bug-management-ui/package.json`.
- Status: corrected for task execution. `npm ci` installed 1,519 packages from the lockfile; the known audit baseline remains 24 vulnerabilities (1 low, 9 moderate, 13 high, 1 critical). No automatic dependency upgrade was applied inside this focused UI fix.
- Product impact: none observed; the focused source checks already passed before this environment correction.
- Verification after dependency correction: IDTS-56 13/13, IDTS-67 29/29, IDTS-93 35/35, IDTS-115 185/185, create-binding 4/4 and the UI5 production build all passed. UI5 MCP targeted linter returned zero findings and manifest validation returned valid with zero errors.
- Independent-review product finding: the first Smart Assign draft synchronization implementation called `submitBatch(model.getUpdateGroupId())`, which can become the reserved `$auto` update group. It also left rejected synchronization promises uncaught at the two UI entry points. Classification load handling initially treated every HTTP 400 as missing Bug context. Classification: product defects found before PR. Status: fixed by submitting only named application groups, polling automatic pending changes for `$auto`/`$direct`, catching both entry points, and matching the exact backend missing-context message while limiting Retry to transient statuses.
- Test-harness improvement: the focused Smart Assign fake OData model now simulates pending `$auto` PATCH work and throws if runtime attempts `submitBatch("$auto")`. Final focused rerun: IDTS-56 `14/14 PASS`; IDTS-115 `189 checks PASS`.
- Tooling issue: the first final CAP command referenced nonexistent `srv/auth-service.cds`. The actual service definition is `srv/auth.cds`; no product compile was attempted by the failed path. Status: corrected by compiling the real file in the final gate.
- Final local gate: all required IDTS-56/66/67/68/69/74/75/76/93/95/114/115 suites passed; IDTS-115 create-binding passed 4/4; secret scan, agent rules and QA-depth self-test passed; both CAP services compiled; UI5 production build, targeted UI5 linter and manifest validation passed; AI DevKit reported 5/5 OK; `git diff --check` passed with only line-ending notices. Ponytail review found no dependency, framework, speculative abstraction or duplicate helper to remove: `Lean already. Ship.`

### 2026-08-05 — Lifecycle close ownership gap (product/business-rule finding)

- Symptom: a PM can close an eligible Bug while another Tester is recorded as `nextProcessorUser_ID`; source review shows another active Tester can do the same.
- Affected flow: `closeBug` from `RESOLVED` or `RETEST_REQUIRED`; UI capability `canClose` and direct OData authorization.
- Root cause: `Tester` and `PM` are both in `COORDINATOR_ROLES`. Both `enforceActionPermission()` and `canClose` authorize by coordinator role and allowed status transition only; neither compares the actor with `nextProcessorUser_ID`.
- Fix status: not changed. Current implementation is internally consistent, but the business policy is ambiguous because Current Action Owner is routing/audit data rather than exclusive action ownership.
- Verification: source trace in `srv/bug-service/permissions.js`, `srv/bug-service/read-models.js`, `srv/bug-service/constants.js`, `srv/bug-service/actions.js`, and `srv/service.js`; existing test catalogs cover Tester/PM close but not a different-Tester denial case.
- Decision needed: choose whether any coordinator may close, only the current Tester may close, or the current Tester plus an explicit PM override may close. If tightened, enforce it in the backend first and mirror it in `canClose` plus positive/negative/race tests.

### 2026-08-05 — PM reporter becomes retest owner with mismatched role (product/data-model finding)

- Symptom: when a PM creates a Bug, later Tester-owned statuses can set the PM user's ID as `nextProcessorUser_ID` while recording `nextProcessorRole_code = TESTER`.
- Root cause: create writes the authenticated actor to `reporter_ID` regardless of whether the actor is Tester or PM. `determineNextProcessor()` then prioritizes `bug.reporter_ID` for every `TESTER_STATUSES` state without validating that the reporter actually has role Tester.
- Impact: Current Action Owner can be a PM while the UI/business role says Tester; a separate designated retest owner does not currently exist.
- Fix status: not changed. A business/data-model decision is required before runtime modification.
- Recommended direction: introduce an explicit active Tester retest owner, default it from the reporter only when the reporter is a Tester, require PM selection before retest when the reporter is PM, and provide PM-controlled reassignment/override with mandatory reason and audit.

### 2026-08-05 — IDTS-122 remote migration entrypoint defect

- Classification: tooling/release defect.
- Symptom: Cloud Foundry task `idts122-migrate-173056` exited `0` without migration output; the subsequent read-only probe reported that the active Bugs table still lacked the retest-owner column.
- Root cause: the helper was transported through `node - --execute`; under Node stdin execution, `require.main === module` is false, so `main()` was never invoked.
- Fix status: in progress on `fix/idts-122-migration-entrypoint-donhv`; the helper now detects only direct stdin execution, exports `main`, and emits a dedicated completion marker only after the execute result, with focused direct-stdin and nested-import regression coverage.
- Safety: the no-op task made no HANA change. Service deployment remains blocked until a successful narrow rerun and read-only post-migration verification. No DB deploy, seed, or broad `cds deploy` was run.

# 2026-08-07 — SAP490 XLSX fidelity guardrail

- Documentation issue: repeated SAP490 XLSX candidates rendered inconsistent gridlines, missing frame edges, faint automatic-color borders, and typography differences between generation output, Excel preview, and LibreOffice/PDF.
- Root cause: the repository had general template-preservation rules but no XLSX-specific, range-level style contract or automated border/grid validator.
- Fix in progress: add mandatory repo-local skill `idts-sap490-xlsx-fidelity`, a policy-driven validator, cross-render checklist, known renderer failure guide, and mandatory routing in `AGENTS.md`/documentation rules.
- Scope: process/tooling only. No current workbook, Google Drive artifact, runtime, or database is changed by this task.
- Process issue: PR #306 initially failed `qa-depth-gate` because its Ownership Knowledge Gate section used narrative wording instead of the exact structured fields required by the repository validator. The PR body was corrected from the existing DonHV PASS record (`3/0/0`, score `90%`, critical/debug/teach-back/result all PASS); the Knowledge Gate was not repeated and no value was invented. The first rerun then exposed a parser-specific evidence-path rule: Markdown backticks prevented the required `docs/...` prefix from matching. The evidence line was changed to the same plain repository paths and this follow-up commit triggers a fresh exact-head check. No bypass is permitted.
